primaryReferences.finding: Unity 6.6 lists ProgressiveGPU and UnityComputeGPU. Do not schedule the old ProgressiveCPU setting from earlier Unity versions.
Synchronous Bake returns a success flag and requires OnDemand workflow. Success additionally requires actual mapped lightmaps and baked light output in our capture checks.
LightingSettings supplies baked GI, lightmapper, resolution, sample and bounce settings for the scene.
A Mixed light can change runtime direct illumination while its baked indirect illumination remains unchanged.

resourceDecision: GPU bake and captures wait for active game use to end; no unrelated process is closed.
